text:
maria: Quick Q — for /v1/chat/responses structured outputs, should we return `null` for optional fields like `summary` when unknown, or omit the key entirely? Seeing clients and SDKs treat null vs missing differently. Planning a small PR to normalize before next week's launch.

jonathan: my vote is to omit optional keys when unknown. `null` tends to leak into typed SDKs as `null` and causes downstream NPEs / extra guards.

akhil: +1 to omit. We had a bug where TS clients did `resp.choice.summary.length` and crashed because it was `null`. Also prefer missing for smaller payloads. We'll need a contract test though.

schema-lint-bot: schema-lint: openapi.yaml: components.schemas.ChatChoice currently marks `summary` as `nullable: true`. Suggest removing `nullable` and making `summary` an optional property (not required).

eva: If we switch to omit, double-check streaming NDJSON + multipart endpoints — parsers expect consistent shapes, some older SDKs fill missing keys with `null`. Also ensure Content-Type explicitness (`application/json; charset=utf-8`) so proxy layer doesn't mutate bodies.

maria: Proposal: default behavior = omit optional fields when unknown. We'll roll this out behind a short-lived header `X-Redwood-Response-Mode: omit-empty-fields` for a 2-week staged rollout so SDK teams can opt-in and we can monitor. @jonathan can you own the PR? @akhil can you add the contract test that fails on null present?

jonathan: I'll open a PR. Plan: change OpenAPI snippets, update schema generator, add changelog note. Also add a small integration test that asserts absence of `summary` in sample responses.

akhil: I'll add a contract test that exercises generated clients against sample payloads (include streaming sample). Also will add guidance to SDKs: treat missing key == unset, do not assume `null`.

schema-lint-bot: ci/contract-tests: failing on `tests/response-samples/omit-summary.json` — current golden expects `summary: null`. Marking test as blocked until PR updates golden.

eva: Also add a tracing field `response_mode` so we can correlate which clients are getting the header during rollout. Will update Console to surface that dimension.

maria: Snippet to use in OpenAPI (proposal):

```
components:
  schemas:
    ChatChoice:
      type: object
      properties:
        text:
          type: string
        summary:
          type: string
      required:
        - text
```

We remove `nullable: true` and do not add `summary` to `required`.

jonathan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-api/pull/1245 — includes OpenAPI change, schema-gen tweak, changelog. CI will run contract tests. @akhil @eva please review when you can.

akhil: Reviewing now. One extra test request: ensure streaming-only endpoint emits NDJSON objects that simply don't include `summary` (no "summary":null), and verify the streaming parser used by our Node SDK tolerates variable object shapes.

eva: Added `response_mode` to tracing context. Also updated console dashboard to filter by that header.

jonathan: CI green locally, remote CI flaky on Windows runners. Requesting review from @akhil by EOD.

akhil: Reviewed and left a couple of minor comments about generator edge cases (enum defaults when key missing).

maria: Nice. I'll proceed with rollout plan after PR merge. Rollout steps: enable header for internal clients, monitor errors and logs for 72h, expand to customers, then remove header after 2 weeks.

jonathan: Will ping here and tag SDK teams in the release notes.

eva: :thumbsup: Logging and tracing will capture traffic.

maria: Thanks all — please ping #eng-sdk if you see any client breakage post-rollout. Closing thread for now, will re-open if issues crop up.
